H5r.also_report: FE regression version as sensitivity; same with external_old
H5r.criterion: supported if estimate < 0 and 95% CI excludes 0 (Holm over 4 confirmatory tests, alpha=0.05)
H5r.estimand: delta_fu(holdout_new) - delta_fu(cohort), paper-weighted, firm-cluster bootstrap 95% CI (B=5000, seed=20261101)
H5r.question: Does the cohort-vs-holdout divergence in delta_fu replicate in the NEW holdout?

P1.criterion: supported if IRR > 1 and 95% CI excludes 0
P1.lag_variants: next block (primary); two blocks ahead (secondary, descriptive)
P1.model: negative binomial; outcome = next-block GX patent applications for firm x GX field; regressor = number (or share) of new-partner entry papers in current block; firm FE, field x block FE; cluster by firm
P1.question: Does new-partner entry precede more technology output?
P1.sample: cohort (existing patent data) + patent-matched external firms from S1

P3.criterion: supported if relative reduction >= 2% and 95% CI excludes 0
P3.design: train on cohort + external_old; evaluate on holdout_new; baseline = past papers + past patents; augmented = baseline + (new-partner share, foreign-univ share, recruitment rate)
P3.metric: relative reduction in out-of-sample Poisson deviance (augmented vs baseline); firm-cluster bootstrap CI
P3.question: Do collaboration indicators improve out-of-sample prediction of next-block GX patent activity beyond past papers and patents?

S1.criterion: selection account supported if estimate > 0 and CI excludes 0; if CI includes 0 and |estimate| < 5 pp, reported as 'no evidence patent holding explains divergence' (no equivalence claim)
S1.estimand: Among external_old + holdout_new: delta_fu(patent_holder_external) - delta_fu(non_holder_external), firm-cluster bootstrap CI
S1.minimum_n: report n firms per cell; if patent holders in external <8, S1 labelled underpowered BEFORE interpretation
S1.question: Does patent holding (selection criterion) explain the divergence?

title: Selection, technology linkage and predictive validity of collaboration signals in Japanese corporate science (GX)

variables.foreign_univ_share: share of a firm's papers in block with >=1 author affiliated with a university (OpenAlex type=education) located outside Japan; paper-weighted pooled over firms
variables.fwci: OpenAlex fwci as retrieved by code35b (retrieval date logged)
variables.new_partner_entry: paper enters a firm-subfield cell not present in prior block AND includes a partner institution new to the firm (definition identical to cohort code)
variables.patent_holder_external: external firm with >=10 GX patents (JPO GX search formula, published 2006-2015), same threshold as cohort
variables.tech_outcome: firm x GX-field x next-block patent applications (count) and forward citations (patent DB, source logged)
